fact_misses.answer: Thanks for your question! Shipping is free within the EU. A printed sample of your own design costs EUR 49 per product (see also "Digital proofs and approval" for physical pre-production proofs).

Thanks for your question! Volume discounts are applied automatically: For custom sizes, special finishes (foil, embossing, soft-touch) or orders above 25,000 units, ask for a quote: our sales team replies within one business day.

Thanks for your question! You can download every invoice as a PDF from Account > Orders > Invoices. To change the company name, address or VAT number on an invoice that was already issued, email billing@kestrelprint.example with the order number within 30 days of the invoice date.
